evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'we just wanted to ask you a few questions in order for us to build an accurate code. You can depend on, sounds good' and 'this would take within the next five to ten minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' — framing is present but rushed past; rep moves to probing without waiting for a full yes to the time-boxed ask.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Hannah Miller), moving day (October 13th), city-to-city route (Inland TX to Frederick TX), and approximate size (750 sq ft origin, 1200 sq ft destination) all asked and confirmed.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asked 'what are your biggest concerns about this move' or equivalent. Rep jumped straight into logistics probing with 'What are your biggest?' then customer interrupts with couch question, which is a concern the customer raised unprompted, not discovered through the agenda-setting question.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised one concern unprompted (couch weight/inclusion). Rep acknowledged with 'Yeah, mm-hmm' and explanation but did not probe deeper with follow-up ('tell me more about that'). No other concerns were raised for rep to follow up on. N/A applies because the rep never established the agenda, and the one concern raised was answered once without layering.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep acknowledged the couch concern with explanation but never reflected back 'so what I'm hearing is...' N/A applies because no formal concerns were raised through the agenda-setting process.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor (third floor at origin, first floor at destination), number of rooms (1 bed origin, 2 bed destination), walking distance (confirmed curb to stairs, 20 feet, 10 seconds to apartment), additional rooms (none besides main apartment), special considerations (narrow stairwell with turns, stairs on 3rd floor at origin), additional stops (two stops: Inland TX and Frederick TX). All seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asks: 'And no need help I packing right?' (phrasing awkward but intent is clear — asking if they need packing help). Customer says 'No.'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep states: 'A typical back count based on your home size is fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' Customer confirms 'around 25 boxes' and mentions mirror.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides typical range: 'typical two bedroom or one bedroom. Apartment would normally take two movers between two and a half to three and a half hours' AND personalizes to this customer: 'We're coming from a one bedroom, apartment located on the third floor with stairs going to the new location which is less than two hours away from the first location, this is a two bedroom apartment located on the first floor. So, we'll send out two movers and one truck estimated time is between five to six hours estimated cost would be $1,377.' Both anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses trip fee ($225) upfront and explains rationale. Rep states 'no hidden fees of any type no credit card fees, no sterle fees, no disassemble or reassembly fees. Again, no hidden fees of any type' and explains minimum: 'We have a minimum of two and a half hours once you go over that it will always be prorated into fifteen minute increments.' Both fee transparency and 2.5-hour minimum/15-minute increments framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent after pricing is delivered. Rep moves directly from estimate explanation into booking availability without gauging customer reaction or holding silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep states 'Finally, I just wanted to let you know that we value your time. So, if you cannot make it.' — sentence is incomplete due to call drop. When rep resumes, says 'Finally, I just wanted to let you know that we don't have hidden fees' instead. On-Time Guarantee is never fully delivered with discount terms. Marked as partial (mentioned incompletely, terms vague/missing).
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep states: 'for any move we have $2,000 that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items in case there are any mishaps' and 'No Worries Damage Coverage included on the R-D weight that you're paying us. We will provide up to 2000 dollars per move. That is to repair replace and reimburse for items.' Coverage amount and purpose are clear, but rep does not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print' framing, and does not clearly state it's built into the rate (rep says 'included on the R-D weight' which is unclear phrasing). Partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent after the two promises section. Rep moves directly from damage coverage explanation into no-hidden-fees explanation without closing the loop. Also, rep repeats the damage coverage ($2,000) a second time in the same flow, which is a minor repeat but not a clear loop-closure. False.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or equivalent at the end. Rep does not conduct a genuine final concerns check. Marked as not_asked.
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: No final concerns check was conducted, so no follow-up opportunity arose. N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent. False.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asks: 'I truly believe that we're the best mover in town would you like or help with your move?' — plainly asked without a built-in out (no 'or I can just email this over'). Full.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states: 'we can be able to book your slot as early as 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM on the 13th of October no deposit required, no reason securing your spot.' Rate lock and no-deposit language present. True.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Customer declines to book on the call ('Let me look around and double-check just to make sure that is a good day. But can I call you all back on a scheduling?'). Rep confirms callback option but does not secure a booking with date, phone, window, crew size, or notes. Partial (only callback option confirmed, not a full booking).

top_strength: Rep gathered complete logistics details methodically (property type, floors, rooms, walking distances, special considerations) and delivered a fully personalized estimate anchored to typical ranges with transparent pricing and fee structures.
coaching_note: Rep skipped the critical "Their Agenda" question entirely—jumping straight into probing rather than discovering what the customer's biggest concerns were before addressing price—and never conducted a final concerns check or confirmed booking details, leaving the call incomplete and passive.
